summary: This directory defines the data structures used to represent the architectural and structural metadata of source files. It provides a standardized format for exchanging information about code symbols, exports, and file paths within the pipeline processing flow.
responsibilities: Defining schema for source file structural metadata
Providing standard interfaces for code symbol summaries
Encapsulating exported declaration and re-export information
relationships: FileConceptInput encapsulates multiple SymbolSummary instances to represent the overall structure of a single file.
The SymbolSummary provides detailed descriptive and structural information for individual code declarations identified within a file.
designDecisions: Strict interface-based contracts for data consistency
Decoupled representation of symbol metadata from source analysis logic
Representation of file contents as an aggregation of exported and re-exported elements
